feeds.title: PowerScore Blog
feeds.description: PowerScore's mission is to help students increase their test scores and assist them with the admissions process. This section of the blog focuses on LSAT exam study tips, tricks and advice.

feeds.title: The University of Texas School of Law
feeds.description: Founded in 1883, The University of Texas School of Law is one of the oldest law schools in the nation. With an enrollment of fourteen hundred degree candidates, the University of Texas School of Law is also one of the nation's largest law schools.

feeds.title: Harvard Law Today News
feeds.description: Harvard Law School is one of the preeminent centers of legal education in the world. Led by a diverse and dedicated group of faculty and legal scholars, HLS provides unmatched opportunities to study law and related disciplines in a rigorous and collaborative environment.

feeds.title: Blue Print LSAT Blog
feeds.description: Blueprint LSAT Prep has the best online, live courses, and LSAT tutoring available. It is the destination for news, advice and analysis covering the LSAT, law school, and life itself.

feeds.title: Lawyer Monthly » Legal Careers
feeds.description: Lawyer Monthly is a news website and monthly legal publication with content that is entirely defined by the significant legal news from around the world. Our editorial focus tracks legal news from across key practices areas, jurisdictions and sectors. We are one of the very few publications that can boast editorial scope in the both the established and emerging markets.

feeds.title: Stetson Law Admissions Blog
feeds.description: Stetson University College of Law provides a dynamic and supportive scholarly community in which students learn, in and outside the classroom and by example, to become outstanding lawyers and leaders who serve the profession and society.

feeds.title: The Fletcher School of Law » Admission Tips
feeds.description: The Fletcher School has prepared the world's leaders to become innovative problem-solvers in government, business and non-governmental organizations with strategic cross-sector networks. Through our ongoing commitment and rigorous approach to advancing world knowledge through research and scholarship, we continue to inform and build bridges to meaningful global solutions. Suggestions from Fletcher admissions on best steps to take when applying to Fletcher or other grad programs.

feeds.title: Survive Law
feeds.description: Survive Law is a team of law students, grads and nerdy mcnerds on a wild and terrifying adventure into the unknown lands of law school and legal careers. From humble beginnings and seed funding from UTS:Law, we're now Australia's leading community of law students online, with 50,000 visitors every month.

feeds.title: Tipping the Scale » Admissions
feeds.description: Tipping the Scales is a hub of practical and unbiased information for law school applicants. From exclusive interviews with top law school deans to in-depth analyses on the perks and pitfalls of a JD, our experts aim to bring you the scoop on law school. We value our community, so let us know what stories you would like to see. THE must-read destination for the best law school applicants to the world's top law schools.

feeds.title: 84 Queens Park
feeds.description: The Faculty of Law is one of the oldest professional faculties at the University of Toronto, with a long and illustrious history. Today, it is one of the world's great law schools, a dynamic academic and social community with more than 50 full-time faculty members and 15-25 distinguished short-term visiting professors from the world's leading law schools, as well as 600 undergraduate and graduate students.

feeds.title: Magoosh LSAT Blog
feeds.description: Our goal is to make the very best of traditional teaching and test prep and share it with students everywhere online. Get everything you need to know about the LSAT.

feeds.title: Law Schooli
feeds.description: Law Schooli will help to prepare for LSAT preparation and law school admission advice. This will help the law students to perform better and get into a good school. Preparation for the exam will also be focussed on.

feeds.title: Pre Law Coach Blog
feeds.description: Applying to and preparing for law school can be daunting. If your plan is to attend law school, but you aren't sure what all you need to do to apply and/or how to put your best foot forward when law school begins, you've come to the right place. PreLawCoach is your one-stop shop for all things law school. I am here to give you quality coaching, advising, and tutoring, at reasonable prices. My passion is preparing students for success, and I want to help you get where you want to go.

feeds.title: Law School Expert Blog
feeds.description: I am dedicated to not only helping clients get into law school, but also make smart decisions that positively impact their lives. I have experience with every step and stage of the law school admissions process. I've written two best-selling law school admissions guidebooks and made admissions decisions at two ABA-approved law schools.

feeds.title: LawCareersNet Blog
feeds.description: LawCareers.Net is the leading research tool for future lawyers. The site is a self-contained, comprehensive one-stop guide to becoming a lawyer. It contains exhaustive core editorial, news and features, advice, immediate vacancies, an events diary and most importantly directories containing details of over 1,250 recruiters of trainee solicitors and barristers as well as nearly 100 providers of post- and undergraduate law courses.

feeds.title: Spivey Consulting Blog
feeds.description: The Spivey Consulting Group was formed in 2012 by Mike Spivey, whose professional career as a senior administrator at three of the top law schools in the nation provides him with a wealth of experience in the legal education and employment arenas. Our mission is to help you get admitted to your dream school. The Blog focuses on law school admissions and legal education.
